messages:
maria: Quick follow-up on the continuous-batching scheduler RFC — we need to pick a clean interface for graceful-fill vs preemptive handoff. My proposal: admission API exposes (1) creditLoan(amount, deadline) and (2) preemptibleLease(id) with a soft-deadline hint. Sketch below.

sam: hmm, creditLoan seems right for smoothing bursts, but how do we signal late-join requests that shouldn't wait for fill? we already have a 'deadline_hint' in the queue item.

kevin: infra concern: if we allow long credit loans we blow up KV cache headroom assumptions. leases need an explicit 'kv_estimate' so eviction can preempt safely.

tara: from evals POV we must avoid silent quality regressions when fallback picks quantized variants during preempt. need a metric hook for model-variant-switch events.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment completed: scheduler-spike v0.2 rolled to canary-1 :rocket:

maria: sketch of API (pseudo):
```json
{
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "deadline_hint_ms": 120,
  "admission": {
    "mode": "creditLoan", // or preemptibleLease
    "credit_tokens": 5,
    "kv_estimate_bytes": 12800
  }
}
```

sam: I worry about surface area. Can we keep queue -> admission facade tiny: Offer(credits, deadline) and Cancel(offer_id). All lease complexity in runtime impl.

kevin: agree. runtime must expose an observable: offer_id -> kv_estimate, lease_state, reclaimed_at. We need to graph these for debugging.

maria: OK agreed to keep facade small. follow-ups: (a) sam to spike Offer/Cancel prototype (b) kevin to add observability fields (c) tara to add variant-switch metric hook. let's sync tomorrow 10am.

tara: +1, will add sample evals to catch silent quality drops.:thumbsup:

sam: will push prototype branch and ping here when done.

kevin: adding simple Prometheus labels: offer_id, tenant, kv_estimate, state. should be enough for now.

maria: nice. thanks everyone — recording this as RFC follow-up notes. :raised_hands:
